name: 🖐️ Steal a Slap!
desc:
🚨 Steal slap gloves and fight to keep them! 🚨

👣 Sneak into bases and steal rare slap gloves!
🌟 Rebirth to unlock new gear and upgrades!
🔥 Protect your base or troll other players!
💥 Battle rivals trying to steal your slap gloves back!
🧠 Outsmart thieves before they reach your stash!

Will you outsmart every thief and become the slap king? 🚨
If you're enjoying the game, don’t forget to give it a thumbs up! 👍
